name: primitives-texts-shimmering
title: Shimmering Text
blurb: Text glimmers with a moving light reflection.
description: Applies a shimmer or highlight effect that moves across text like a light source sweeping side-to-side.
use_when: Skeleton loaders or premium text elements.
avoid_when: Body text — shimmer is distracting to read.
a11y: Text is readable but animation runs continuously. No motion preference support.
